news.headline: 'Uptober' Starts Green as Bitcoin ETFs Draw $134 Million
news.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs pulled in $134.4M in October's first two trading days, reversing September's outflows as a softer jobs report eased expectations for further Fed rate hikes. The inflow signals renewed investor appetite for crypto amid shifting monetary policy signals.

news.headline: 'We Have Identified You, Sir': Near Intents Recovers $3.8 Million After 48-Hour Ultimatum
news.summary: Near Protocol's Intents platform recovered $3.8M in stolen funds within 24 hours after publicly identifying the attacker and issuing a 48-hour ultimatum. The exploit drained the platform Thursday, but the direct approach worked—funds were returned in full, demonstrating an unconventional but effective recovery method in crypto.

educational.title: What a Recession Actually Means (And What It Doesn't)
points: A recession is broadly defined as a significant decline in economic activity
It's not the same as a stock market crash — they can happen independently
Recessions typically bring rising unemployment and falling consumer spending
They're a normal part of economic cycles, not a rare catastrophe
Historically, markets have recovered from every recession, though timing varies
